---
title: "PROC FREQ"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(sasonr)
```

PROC FREQ counts the values of variables: one-way tables with percentages and
cumulative columns, two-way tables with row and column percentages, and the
chi-square tests of a two-way table.

```{r}
prog <- "
options nocenter;
data ae;
  input subj $ arm $ sev $;
  datalines;
S01 A MILD
S02 A MILD
S03 A SEVERE
S04 B MILD
S05 B MODERATE
S06 B SEVERE
S07 B SEVERE
;
run;
"
```

## One-way tables

```{r}
res <- sas_run(paste(prog, "proc freq data=ae; tables sev; run;"))
cat(res$listing, sep = "\n")
```

## Two-way tables

```{r}
res <- sas_run(paste(prog, "proc freq data=ae; tables arm*sev; run;"))
cat(res$listing, sep = "\n")
```

## OUT= data sets

`OUT=` on the TABLES statement writes the counts and percentages as a data set.

```{r}
res <- sas_run(paste(prog, "proc freq data=ae noprint; tables arm*sev / out=counts; run;"))
res$work$counts
```

## On a data frame

`sas_freq_df()` runs a one-way table on a data frame.

```{r}
df <- data.frame(sev = c("MILD", "MILD", "SEVERE"))
as.data.frame(sas_freq_df(df, "sev"))
```
